sourceChecks.text: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
sourceChecks.reasonJa: The preceding verse locates the following list within the half-tribe of Manasseh.
sourceChecks.previousContext: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.
sourceChecks.nextContext: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

sourceChecks.nextContext: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

sourceChecks.text: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.
sourceChecks.reasonJa: WEB5:23–24 places the list within the half-tribe of Manasseh. The dedicated Wikipedia Epher page read during search covers only the Midianite son in Genesis 25:4 and does not identify the Manassite house-head in 5:24.
sourceChecks.previousContext: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
sourceChecks.nextContext: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.
